summary: Verified SRV file-attachment fix end-to-end. FileDropzone now uploads real files to POST /api/upload during the wizard (thumbnail visible in file-list during creation), and the new SolicitudView 'Archivos adjuntos' card displays the uploaded image as a clickable thumbnail on /solicitud/{codigo}. Persistence after full reload confirmed (image URL pointing to /api/files/... is re-rendered from the persisted path). 'Enlace de seguimiento' card + copy-track-button present. Admin status update (estado-select, estado-comentario, registrar-estado) records new entry in historial. Backend regression: /api/upload and /api/public/upload accept PNG and PDF (<=10MB) and reject text/plain with 400 'Solo se permiten imágenes o PDF'.

issues: Radix warning: DialogContent requires a DialogTitle for accessibility (screen readers). Add a visually-hidden DialogTitle.

action_items: (Minor a11y) Add a DialogTitle (or VisuallyHidden wrapper) inside the success-modal DialogContent in NuevaSolicitud.js to silence Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: FileDropzone uploads files sequentially in a for-loop; consider Promise.all for parallel uploads of many files.
SolicitudView.js still duplicates flowIndex / fmt helpers found in RequestDetail.js — extract to shared util (carry-over from iteration 6).

FileDropzone type detection stores raw MIME as `type` but the fallback branch stores the file extension string — a bit inconsistent; isImg handles both but a normalized {mime,ext} shape would be cleaner.
seed_data_creation: Created SRV-2026-000123 (Instalación, GrandBay, Bogotá – Planta Principal) with 1 PNG attachment for verification. Data lives in localStorage (mocked) but the uploaded image is persisted in backend object storage at qr-asset-desk/uploads/*.png.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Wizard testids: btn-siguiente, btn-crear, btn-ver, select-cliente, select-ubicacion, input-contacto, input-telefono, input-fecha, select-horario, input-cantidad, select-dispensador, file-dropzone, file-input, file-list, file-remove-{i}. SolicitudView testids: solicitud-view, view-codigo, estado-badge, archivos-card, archivo-{i}, copy-track-button, estado-select, estado-comentario, registrar-estado, historial. To upload use page.set_input_files on [data-testid=file-input] (hidden). Backend upload endpoints validated: /api/upload (auth) and /api/public/upload (public) — accept image/pdf, reject others with 400.
rca of the issue: Root cause was FileDropzone previously only stored file metadata client-side, never POSTing to /api/upload; so archivos in the created solicitud had no `path` and SolicitudView had no card to render. Fix (already applied by main agent) uploads each file via ensureSession()+api.post('/upload'), stores the returned server path in form.archivos, and SolicitudView renders an thumbnail inside archivos-card. Verified thumbnails render in the wizard AND on /solicitud/{codigo}, and survive a full page reload.
